d: India is making a determined push to position itself as a global investment and manufacturing powerhouse, but the road is proving to be uneven. On one hand, New Delhi is overhauling its tax framework to offer greater certainty, attract multinational companies, and encourage global supply chains to shift from China. The proposed Taxation and Other Laws Amendment Bill seeks to make India a more attractive destination for manufacturers, offshore funds, data centres, and long-term foreign investment, reinforcing its ambition to become a global hub for production and business operations.
